learning_outcomes.text: Acquaint students with the principles of electronic commerce.
Focus on the technical implementation of commercial portals, e-shops, content management systems, etc.
Gain knowledge of basic concepts and directions of trading, internet marketing, SWOT analysis and design and configuration of marketing strategy in the internet environment.
Describe the practical implementation and an overview of the technologies used for the development and management of projects, electronic payment channels and banking.
Discuss the issues of related legislation, principles of creating business conditions, personal data protection (ÚOOU, GDPR), etc.
Be able to construct an analysis of a business plan, based on which it will analyze and implement an online commercial solution using existing technologies or using its own implementation.

Be able to design traffic analysis, SEO optimization, including UX and related marketing and advertising campaign settings, and will be able to evaluate their success with respect to the required conversion goals.

syllabus_topics: Basic directions of business on the Internet, modern directions of business, explanation of basic concepts (B2B, B2C, B2G, etc.)
Specification of the business plan, and its yoke influence on the choice of suitable technologies for its implementation (e-shops, content management systems, etc.)
SWOT analysis, within the business on the Internet and the suitability of the technologies used.
Monitoring statistics of web applications, basic indicators for SEO optimization, testing the quality of website processing with respect to the business plan
Image and corporate identity with respect to the UI, with the possibility of adding a corporate identity
Implementation of SEO and UX in terms of internet marketing and required conversions
Internet marketing, statistics of traffic and effectiveness of advertising campaigns, monitoring their success and occupancy
Social networks from the point of view of marketing, monitoring users, logging in using a Facebook account, creating and managing audiences
Emailing, how to implement campaigns via email / SMS and related legislation
Affiliate how affiliate programs work, what they are, the model of commission systems
Privacy Policy GDPR, ePrivacy, Cokkies, Trademarks
2FA, OAuth security, transaction verification and electronic banking users

Electronic payment channels, receipt of electronic payments, credit cards, bank transfers, electronic banking and its connection to accounting applications, interbank relations, foreign payments, focus on online payments, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay

Business and legislation in terms of software development contract for work as a SW developer, business conditions for the e-shop, and related legislation for operators and developers of the e-shop, complaint procedure, etc.
Introduction to e-business (Exercise)
Definition of business plan, determination of product price, service, profitability, cost estimation (Exercise)
testing individual principles and technologies for the establishment of an e-shop, content management system, development of your own solution (Exercise)
Setting up and working with Google Analytics (Exercise)
Visual presentation of a product or service with regard to the creation of content for Internet marketing (Exercise)
Payment channels, their implementation and use (Exercise)
Presentation of achieved results (Exercise)
Team work, organization of teamwork, division of tasks, planning (Exercise)
teaching_methods: Teaching by an expert (lecture or tutorial)
